description_en: Creates a data quality evaluation task instance
description_zh: 创建数据质量校验任务实例
name: CreateDataQualityEvaluationTaskInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data quality evaluation task
parameters.name: data_quality_evaluation_task_id

fields.help_en: The identifier of the scheduling resource group configured for the task to run
fields.help_zh: 任务运行配置的调度资源组标识符
fields.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en: The CU consumption configured for the task to run. This parameter must be specified if a serverless resource group is used
fields.help_zh: 任务运行配置CU消耗，如果使用了Serverless资源组，需要指定这个参数
fields.name: cu

parameters.help_en: The resource group information. This parameter is required when you run a data quality evaluation on a non-MaxCompute data source
parameters.help_zh: 资源组信息，运行非MaxCompute数据质量校验时需要填写
parameters.name: runtime_resource

parameters.help_en:
The execution parameters of the data quality evaluation in the JSON format. The following keys are available:
triggerTime: the millisecond timestamp of the trigger time. This is the base time for the $[yyyymmdd] expression in the data range of data quality monitoring. This key is required
parameters.help_zh:
数据质量校验执行参数，JSON格式，可用的key如下：
triggerTime：触发时间的毫秒时间戳，数据质量监控的数据范围中$[yyyymmdd]表达式的基准时间，必填
parameters.name: parameters

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the ID.

This parameter specifies the DataWorks workspace in which this API operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间管理页面获取ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id
